title: Vacuum gripper with a plurality of longitudinal isolating elements

features.item: A housing with a grip portion designed as a hollow body for gripping
An electrically operated vacuum generating device in the housing
features.quote: The suction joint 3 attaches to an item providing low pressure or vacuum and connects to the vacuum gripper.
features.note: The reference discloses a suction joint for providing low pressure or vacuum, but does not specify that the vacuum generating device is electrically operated or located within the housing itself.

features.item: Exhaust air from the vacuum generating device guided through the hollow grip portion to an air outlet
A sound-damping device arranged in the grip portion
A suction plate comprising a carrier plate and a seal fastened to the carrier plate extending around it
A grip unit with hollow grip portion, electrically operated vacuum generator, exhaust air routed through grip to outlet, and sound-damping device in grip
Vacuum handling apparatus with suction plate and grip unit combined
Grip portion at least partially lined with sound-damping material
Vacuum generating device arranged completely in a first housing portion
Sound-reducing device in the first housing portion or first housing portion lined with sound-reducing material
Grip portion elongated between first and second housing portions with air outlet on second housing portion
Air collection screw upstream of grip portion in first housing portion for collecting exhaust air
Bent or curved air baffles downstream of grip portion directing exhaust air to air outlet
Battery coupling point on second housing portion with air baffles directing exhaust air away from battery coupling point
Grip unit and suction plate releasably connected via a coupling device
Grip unit with suction opening fluidically connected to suction chamber delimited by suction plate
features.quote: The low pressure that is transmitted from suction joint 3 at suction holes 12 will then draw the gripping element and the object against each other, and the isolating elements will be pushed into the arrangement.
features.note: The reference describes a suction joint connected to suction holes that create low pressure in an opening/cavity, which is functionally similar to a suction chamber. However, it does not explicitly mention a 'grip unit' or 'suction plate' as defined in the feature.

claims.note: The reference describes a vacuum gripper for machine handling of objects, not a grip unit for a hand-operated laying device with a suction plate.

claims.quote: The present invention is related to a vacuum gripper for the machine handling of objects, with a housing (1) where a vacuum can be applied through at least one channel
claims.note: The reference discloses a housing and a vacuum generating device (implied by 'vacuum can be applied through at least one channel'), but it does not mention a 'grip portion for gripping the grip unit' or that the vacuum generating device is 'electrically operated'.
The reference does not describe a grip portion designed as a hollow body.
The reference does not describe exhaust air being guided through a grip portion to an air outlet, nor a sound-damping device.
This reference describes a vacuum gripper for machine handling of objects, not a hand-operated laying device with a grip portion and a sound-damping device.
This reference does not describe a grip portion lined with sound-damping material.
This reference does not describe a vacuum generating device arranged completely in a first housing portion.
This reference does not describe a sound-reducing device in a housing portion or a housing portion lined with sound-reducing material.

The reference describes a vacuum gripper with a housing and isolating elements, but does not mention a grip portion elongated between a first and second housing portion, nor an air outlet arranged on a second housing portion.

The reference describes a vacuum gripper with a housing and isolating elements, but does not mention an air collection device in the form of an air collection screw, nor its arrangement upstream of a grip portion in a first housing portion.

The reference describes a vacuum gripper with a housing and isolating elements, but does not mention bent or curved air baffles arranged downstream of a grip portion or in a second housing portion for guiding exhaust air.

The reference describes a vacuum gripper, but does not mention a battery coupling point for an electrical energy storage device or rechargeable battery arranged on the housing or a second housing portion.
This reference does not disclose air baffles for directing exhaust air away from a battery coupling point.

claims.quote: [abstract] The present invention is related to a vacuum gripper for the machine handling of objects, with a housing (1) where a vacuum can be applied through at least one channel, and a plurality of longitudinal isolating elements (2) associated
claims.note: The reference discloses a vacuum gripper for machine handling of objects, which is a type of vacuum handling apparatus. However, it does not explicitly mention a 'suction plate comprising a carrier plate and a seal'.
This reference does not disclose a suction plate comprising a carrier plate and a seal fastened to it and extending around it.

claims.quote: [abstract] The present invention is related to a vacuum gripper for the machine handling of objects, with a housing (1) where a vacuum can be applied through at least one channel, and a plurality of longitudinal isolating elements (2) associated
claims.note: The reference describes a vacuum gripper with a housing and isolating elements, which is a grip unit. However, the full claim 1 of the subject invention is not provided, so a complete assessment of 'said grip unit according to claim 1' cannot be made.
This reference does not describe a grip unit and a suction plate being releasably connected via a coupling device.

claims.quote: The figure also shows a hole for flushing 7 of the outer casing 20 and a suction joint 3 in the hollow part 6. The gripper includes an opening or suction part 5, which also appears from the figure .
claims.note: The reference describes a suction opening (part 5) and a suction joint (part 3) which creates a vacuum, consistent with a grip unit having a suction opening fluidically connected to a suction chamber to generate a vacuum.
claims.refuted: The quote mentions a suction joint and suction opening but does not describe a suction chamber delimited by a suction plate or the mechanism for generating vacuum between a suction plate and object.

overall.why: The reference describes a vacuum gripper with a housing and movable isolating elements for handling objects, which is in the same broad area as the subject invention.
